description: Seneffe - bulles à verre, bulles à textiles et points d'apport volontaire is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Commune de Seneffe. Cette base de données répertorie l’ensemble des bulles à textiles "Terre" (conteneurs pour vêtements et textiles) installées sur le territoire de la commune de Seneffe. The 3 datasets in this record: Bulles à textiles - Seneffe; Bulles à verre - Seneffe; Points d'apport volontaire - Seneffe. Coverage: Seneffe. The portal lists 3 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Qualité de Vie. Its keywords are BullesATextiles, Bulles, Textiles, Vêtements. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2025-07-24 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
